title: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
why_read: A notable example of an AI model reasoning about the historical/technical origins of cryptographic curve parameters, touching on real suspicions in applied cryptography.
analysis: This concerns Claude being asked about the origin of certain ECDSA elliptic curve parameters, a topic with real history around NIST curve generation and long-standing suspicion about whether seeds were chosen innocuously or with hidden backdoors. The discussion is interesting because it blends cryptographic trust questions with LLM capabilities for historical/technical research synthesis. It's a good read for anyone interested in applied cryptography history and how well LLMs can surface or hallucinate nuanced technical claims.
